thesis: CRAI is a good business bought at the wrong time. The stock is at its 52-week high with RSI 75 after a +18.5% 21-day run, while the market is in a high-confidence risk-off regime with VIX at its 99.5th percentile. Small-cap, thinly covered names with net debt tend to gap hardest when index selling accelerates, and a defensive posture favours small sizing for new long swing entries. The CEO is selling into the highs and the Barrington target raise is already in the price. Reward/risk of 1.84 is mediocre for a trade that needs a pullback fill in a falling tape, and a failed 218.5 breakout would send price back toward the SMA20 and the stop.
